svg.title: Draw it: one digit becoming ten scores
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw the picture and every block of the stack with its shape written on it; write the weight count under each block and mark the three that hold zero; and draw the ten scores at the end with an arrow from the biggest one to the answer.
svg.text: Draw it: one digit becoming ten scores
1. the picture, then every block of the stack, with its shape written on it
2. the weight count written under each block, and the three that hold zero
3. the ten scores at the end, with an arrow from the biggest one to the answer
